installed.title: Installed apps
installed.intro: Apps installed on this box. Everyone finds the apps they may use in their Pithyx menu.
installed.empty: No apps are installed yet. Install one from its package file (.pithyxapp).
installed.pool: App data lives on the pool {pool}.

detail.enabledHint: A disabled app keeps its data and who may use it, but nobody can open it.

source.sideload: Installed from a file, not verified

detail.unavailable: The pool with the app's data is not available. Nobody can open the app until it is back.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.intro: Turn a permission off to take it from the app. It stays off after updates. Open windows of the app get the change within a few minutes.
permissions.none: The app asks for no permissions.

storage.title: Folders
storage.intro: The app asks for these folders. Map each one to a folder in a shared folder; it keeps its rights, snapshots and backups and stays when the app is removed.
storage.requiredMissing: Not mapped yet. The app needs this folder to start its background service.
storage.pathHint: Leave it empty for the shared folder itself. The folder must exist.
storage.noShares: There are no shared folders yet. Create one in Settings first.

access.title: Who may use it
access.label: Who may use the app
access.loading: Loading who may use the app

logs.title: Logging
logs.debug: Send debug messages to the Log Center
logs.hint: Switch this on only to find a problem: some apps write many debug messages. Information, warnings and errors always reach the Log Center.

policy.title: Updates
policy.label: When a catalog has a newer version
policy.box: As set in the Store's settings
policy.hint: An update that asks for new permissions or special rights never installs on its own.

rollback.title: Back to the previous version of {name}
rollback.warning: {version} returns with the app's data as it was before the update. Changes since the update and snapshots of the app taken since are lost. If updates install on their own, this app announces them from now on.

permission.unknown: A permission this version of Pithyx does not explain.

read.title: Read files
read.description: Reads files in the shared folders of the user who uses it.

write.title: Change files
write.description: Creates, changes and deletes files in the shared folders the user may write to.

shares.title: See shared folders
shares.description: Sees which shared folders the user may use.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Shows notifications to the user who uses it.

read.title: See all users and groups
read.description: Sees the names of every user and group on this box, not only the user who uses it.

internet.title: Internet
internet.description: Connects to servers on the internet. Without it, the app stays on this box.

lan.title: Local network
lan.description: Its background service connects to other devices in your network, such as a router, a printer or another server.

install.title: Install an app

action.reinstall: Version {version} is installed already. Installing it again replaces its files.
action.downgrade: Version {version} is older than the installed version {installed}. Its data may not fit.

install.unverified: This package comes from a file and is not verified. Install only apps from developers you trust.
install.keptData: This app was installed before and its data was kept. It gets that data and its user id back.
install.noPermissions: The app asks for no permissions.
install.storageHint: Map them to folders after the install.

backend.yes: Brings its own background service in containers.
backend.no: Runs in the browser only, without a background service.

install.root: A container of this app runs as root. Pithyx keeps it without rights on the box itself, but install it only if you trust the developer.
install.accessSuggested: Suggested for this app: administrators only, because it may see every user, runs as root in a container or asks for special rights.
install.poolHint: Every app keeps its data on this pool. It cannot change while an app is installed.
install.noPools: There is no pool that can hold apps. Create one in Storage first.
install.fromCatalog: From the catalog {catalog}, checked against its signature.
install.fromCustomCatalog: From the catalog {catalog}, which is not verified: only install apps from catalogs you trust.

uninstall.title: Uninstall {name}?
uninstall.keepHint: Its files stay on the app pool. Installing the app again finds them.
uninstall.deleteHint: Its databases, settings and other files on the app pool are deleted with every snapshot. This cannot be undone.
uninstall.mapped: Folders mapped to the app stay in their shared folders either way.

official.title: Official apps
official.intro: Apps of the Pithyx project, reviewed, built and signed by the project.

community.title: Community apps
community.intro: Apps from developers outside the project. The project reviews them before they are published, but cannot vouch for them as for its own apps. You can switch this catalog off in the Store settings.

own.title: Your catalogs
own.intro: Apps of the catalogs you added. They are not verified by the Pithyx project.

catalog.empty: This catalog has no apps for this box yet.
catalog.failedNotice: The last fetch of {name} failed; the apps shown come from its last checked copy. The Store's settings say why.
catalog.unverified: This catalog is not verified by the Pithyx project. Only install apps from catalogs you trust.
catalog.sourceLink: Source of this version in the catalog

updates.title: Updates
updates.intro: Newer versions of installed apps. The Store's settings decide what the box does with them on its own.
updates.newPermissions: {count, plural, one {Asks for # new permission} other {Asks for # new permissions}}
updates.automatic: Installs on its own at the next check

policy.automatic: Waits for you: it asks for more

updates.title: Updates
updates.policy: When a catalog has a newer version

policyHints.automatic: Updates that ask for new permissions or special rights still wait for you.
policyHints.notify: A notification on the desktops of administrators.
policyHints.none: Updates only appear in the tab Updates.

updates.timeHint: HH:MM in the box's time zone. Each box adds its own delay of up to an hour.
updates.notifications: Administrators get desktop notifications about updates and catalogs that cannot be fetched.

channel.title: Channel
channel.betaHint: Every new version as soon as a catalog publishes it, before its release.

catalogs.title: Catalogs
catalogs.verified: Checked {time}, {count, plural, one {# app} other {# apps}}.
catalogs.deployKeyHint: This catalog is private: its repository must have this key as a read-only deploy key.
catalogs.deployKeyNext: Add this key to the repository as a deploy key without write access, then fetch the catalog in the Store's settings.
catalogs.hostKey: Server key pinned at the first connection: {key}
catalogs.urlHint: https://… for a public catalog, git@host:owner/repository.git for a private one.
catalogs.addWarning: Apps of your own catalogs are not checked by the Pithyx project. Add only catalogs you trust.

community.title: Use the community catalog?
community.warning: Community apps come from developers outside the Pithyx project. The project reviews them before they are published, but cannot vouch for them as for its own apps.

file.title: Install from a file
file.intro: Install an app from its package file (.pithyxapp). Such apps are not verified.
